description: This file defines the WorkWeekDao class responsible for data access operations related to WorkWeek entities, such as saving, retrieving by ID, and checking non-working days, in the OrangeHRM Leave plugin.

classes.name: WorkWeekDao
classes.description: Data access object for managing WorkWeek entities, providing methods for saving and querying work week data, including checking for non-working days.

methods.name: saveWorkWeek
methods.description: Persists a WorkWeek entity to the database and returns the same entity.

methods.name: getWorkWeekById
methods.description: Retrieves a WorkWeek entity by its unique ID.

methods.name: isNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Checks if a given date is a non-working day or half-day based on the WorkWeek settings.
